## Sarasota County Age Distribution

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)

# Cache downloaded Census map boundaries so future renders are fast
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Define the 5-year age group percentage variables from ACS Table S0101
age_vars <- c(
  "Under 5" = "S0101_C02_002",
  "5 to 9" = "S0101_C02_003",
  "10 to 14" = "S0101_C02_004",
  "15 to 19" = "S0101_C02_005",
  "20 to 24" = "S0101_C02_006",
  "25 to 29" = "S0101_C02_007",
  "30 to 34" = "S0101_C02_008",
  "35 to 39" = "S0101_C02_009",
  "40 to 44" = "S0101_C02_010",
  "45 to 49" = "S0101_C02_011",
  "50 to 54" = "S0101_C02_012",
  "55 to 59" = "S0101_C02_013",
  "60 to 64" = "S0101_C02_014",
  "65 to 69" = "S0101_C02_015",
  "70 to 74" = "S0101_C02_016",
  "75 to 79" = "S0101_C02_017",
  "80 to 84" = "S0101_C02_018",
  "85 and over" = "S0101_C02_019"
)

# Download 5-year ACS data for Sarasota County, FL
sarasota_ages <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  county = "Sarasota",
  variables = age_vars,
  year = 2022
) |>
  # Keep the age groups in age order instead of alphabetical order
  mutate(variable = fct_inorder(variable))

# Create a bar chart of age group percentages
ggplot(sarasota_ages, aes(x = variable, y = estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7da0", color = "#1b4965", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution in Sarasota County, FL",
    subtitle = "Notice the large share of residents aged 60 and older",
    x = "Age Group (Years)",
    y = "Percentage of Population (%)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018-2022 American Community Survey (Table S0101)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Sarasota County Interactive Age Map

```{r}
# Find the top 2 largest age groups for each census tract in Sarasota County
top_two_ages <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  state = "FL",
  county = "Sarasota",
  variables = age_vars,
  year = 2022
) |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  # Keep the 2 age groups with the highest percentage in each tract
  slice_max(estimate, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE, by = GEOID) |>
  summarize(
    top_groups = paste0(variable, " (", estimate, "%)", collapse = "<br>"),
    .by = GEOID
  )

# Download median age (B01002_001) and map boundaries for each census tract
sarasota_map <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  state = "FL",
  county = "Sarasota",
  variables = "B01002_001",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  # Remove empty water tracts and convert to standard latitude/longitude (WGS84) for Leaflet
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(top_two_ages, by = "GEOID") |>
  # Build the HTML hover tooltip showing tract name, median age, and top 2 age groups
  mutate(
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<strong>", str_remove(NAME, "; Sarasota County; Florida"), "</strong><br>",
      "Median Age: ", estimate, "<br>",
      "<strong>Top 2 Age Groups:</strong><br>", top_groups
    )
  )

# Create a color palette for median age
age_pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "plasma", domain = sarasota_map$estimate)

# Build the interactive map with hover tooltips
leaflet(sarasota_map) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~age_pal(estimate),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~map(hover_label, \(x) htmltools::HTML(x))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = age_pal,
    values = ~estimate,
    title = "Median Age",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

## Statewide Florida Age Distribution

```{r}
# Download 5-year ACS age distribution data for the entire state of Florida
florida_ages <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  state = "FL",
  variables = age_vars,
  year = 2022
) |>
  # Keep the age groups in age order instead of alphabetical order
  mutate(variable = fct_inorder(variable))

# Create a bar chart of age group percentages for all of Florida
ggplot(florida_ages, aes(x = variable, y = estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#e07a5f", color = "#9e4731", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution in Florida",
    subtitle = "Statewide age distribution across 5-year age groups",
    x = "Age Group (Years)",
    y = "Percentage of Population (%)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018-2022 American Community Survey (Table S0101)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Statewide Florida Interactive Age Map

```{r}
# Find the top 2 largest age groups for each county in Florida
fl_top_two_ages <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  variables = age_vars,
  year = 2022
) |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  # Keep the 2 age groups with the highest percentage in each county
  slice_max(estimate, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE, by = GEOID) |>
  summarize(
    top_groups = paste0(variable, " (", estimate, "%)", collapse = "<br>"),
    .by = GEOID
  )

# Download median age (B01002_001) and map boundaries for each Florida county
florida_map <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  variables = "B01002_001",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  # Remove empty geometries and convert to standard latitude/longitude (WGS84) for Leaflet
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(fl_top_two_ages, by = "GEOID") |>
  # Build the HTML hover tooltip showing county name, median age, and top 2 age groups
  mutate(
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<strong>", str_remove(NAME, ", Florida"), "</strong><br>",
      "Median Age: ", estimate, "<br>",
      "<strong>Top 2 Age Groups:</strong><br>", top_groups
    )
  )

# Create a color palette for Florida county median age
fl_age_pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "plasma", domain = florida_map$estimate)

# Build the interactive Florida map with hover tooltips
leaflet(florida_map) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~fl_age_pal(estimate),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~map(hover_label, \(x) htmltools::HTML(x))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = fl_age_pal,
    values = ~estimate,
    title = "Median Age",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
